A '''bird''' with pink feathers and a yellow beak lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. When the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] accidentally fell into a bush during his [[Skills test]], the bird's nest with the bird inside was on the top of his head when he poked his head out of the bush. The bird then started quickly tapping its [[Drill/Legends|drill]]-like beak against Wicket's forehead, and its entire body started shaking since its beak was moving so quickly, while Wicket winced and closed his eyes in pain and annoyance.<ref name="2-18" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bird appeared in a flashback scene in the season two ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' episode "[[Just My Luck]]." Its behavior strongly resembles that of a real-life woodpecker.<ref name="2-18" />
